actions.finding: TOCTOU race in getHandler: entry read under RLock, expiry check and delete happen unlocked
actions.description: Added re-check under write lock before deleting expired entry. The delete now verifies the entry's ExpiresAt still matches the originally-read value, preventing silent data loss when setHandler writes a fresh entry between RUnlock and Lock.

actions.finding: Test isolation: tests mutate package-level cache without resetting between test functions
actions.description: Added resetCache helper that acquires cacheMu and replaces the cache map. Called at the start of every test function to ensure test independence under -shuffle or when new tests are added.

summary: Addressed both review findings: fixed TOCTOU race in getHandler by re-checking entry under write lock before delete, and added resetCache test helper for test isolation. All tests pass with -race.
